from pathlib import Path
path=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u071/system/state/workspace/programs/task-44bbb65d.py')
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    best_color = 0
    best_size = 0
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            size = 0
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                size += 1
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        stack.append((ny,nx))
            if size > best_size:
                best_color, best_size = color, size
    return [[best_color] * 3 for _ in range(3)]
'''
path.write_text(source)
assert path.exists()
